title: Yoshikawa Santoku Knife 165mm
description_en: Hand-forged in the knife capital of Japan, this Yoshikawa Santoku features a 3-layer steel core clad in 16-layer Damascus. Razor-sharp edge retention, perfect balance — a chef's knife that lasts generations.
description_ja: 刃物の町・岐阜産の本格三徳包丁。16層ダマスカス鋼に包まれた3層鋼構造。切れ味の持続性と絶妙なバランスが世代を超えて使える一本。
